name: bajra
sowing_season: Kharif: late June–July with the first good monsoon rain | Summer: March (irrigated, Gujarat and Rajasthan)
soil: Light sandy loam to loam; grows in poor, dry soil, pH 6.5–8.0; does not like waterlogging

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.description: Seeds sprout in 3–5 days in warm, moist soil.
stages.irrigation: Sow after a good monsoon shower, when the soil is moist 10–15 cm deep.
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 40 kg DAP per acre (add 20 kg MOP on light soil). Treat seed with Metalaxyl 35 SD 6 g per kg against downy mildew.
watch_for: Shoot fly — the central shoot dries (dead heart)
tips: Seed rate 1.5–2 kg per acre; rows 45 cm apart
Remove ergot from seed: stir it in salt water (2 kg salt in 10 litres) and throw away what floats

stages.name: Tillering
stages.description: Side shoots form and the plant spreads.
stages.irrigation: Usually rain-fed; give one irrigation in a long dry spell.
stages.fertilizer: Top dress 35 kg urea per acre at 25–30 days when the soil is moist (45 kg for an irrigated crop).
watch_for: Downy mildew — yellow leaves with white growth underneath
tips: Thin plants to 10–15 cm apart and fill gaps with the pulled seedlings at 15–20 days
Hand weed or hoe once at 20–25 days

stages.name: Panicle Initiation
stages.description: The ear head starts forming inside the stem.
stages.irrigation: Keep the soil moist — a critical stage for water.
watch_for: Downy mildew turning ears leafy (green ear)
tips: Pull out and destroy plants with downy mildew

stages.name: Heading / Flowering
stages.irrigation: Irrigate if dry — water stress at flowering means poor grain set.
watch_for: Ergot — sticky, honey-like drops on the ears
Smut — green, then black, swollen grains
tips: Cut out ears with ergot or smut and burn them

stages.name: Grain Filling
stages.description: Grains fill from milky to hard.
stages.irrigation: One more irrigation at the milk–dough stage if the soil is dry.
tips: Scare birds away in the morning and evening

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
stages.description: Grains are hard and the plant turns pale.
watch_for: Grain loss and bird damage if harvest is late
tips: Cut the ears first, dry them and then thresh
Dry grain to 12% moisture before storage

common_pests.name: Shoot fly
common_pests.symptoms: Central shoot of young plants dries (dead heart)
common_pests.control: Sow early with the first rains; use a slightly higher seed rate and pull out dead hearts

common_pests.name: Stem borer
common_pests.symptoms: Dead hearts in older plants, holes in the stem
common_pests.control: Destroy stubbles after harvest; release Trichogramma egg-parasite cards (ask your KVK)

common_pests.name: White grub
common_pests.symptoms: Plants wilt and dry in patches
common_pests.control: Deep summer ploughing; collect beetles from trees after the first rains

common_diseases.name: Downy mildew (green ear)
common_diseases.symptoms: Yellow streaks with white growth under leaves; ears turn into leafy structures
common_diseases.control: Seed treatment with Metalaxyl 35 SD 6 g per kg; resistant hybrids; remove affected plants

common_diseases.name: Ergot
common_diseases.symptoms: Pink, honey-like drops on ears; later hard dark bodies replace the grains
common_diseases.control: Clean the seed in salt water; remove affected ears

common_diseases.name: Smut
common_diseases.symptoms: Grains turn into green, then black sacs of powder
common_diseases.control: Crop rotation; remove and burn affected ears
